form:FormGroup.label: Change
form:FormGroup.helpText: The change to make to every processor filter in the current filtered list: Enable, Disable, Delete or Set run as user. You are asked to confirm before the change is applied.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Applies to every processor filter in the current filtered list.

form:FormGroup.label: Run As User
form:FormGroup.helpText: The user whose permissions are used when the filtered processor filters run. Only shown when Change is Set run as user, and a user must be selected.
